opportunities.name: Resy: book a Special Events & Experiences ticket
opportunities.description: On Resy, open the Special Events & Experiences list for a given city, pick an event, set the ticket quantity, choose the ticket tier or time slot, and reserve.
steps: Open resy.com and switch the city selector to the target city (or open 'See more' under Special Events & Experiences)
Open the Special Events & Experiences listing
Select the ticket quantity in the tickets dropdown
Click 'Book Now' for the ticket tier, or the time-slot button
Click 'Reserve Now' in the Complete Your Reservation dialog
